annotation.title_clean: Part 850—Provisions Pertaining to U.S. Investments in Certain National Security Technologies and Products in Countries of Concern
annotation.title_en: Part 850—Provisions Pertaining to U.S. Investments in Certain National Security Technologies and Products in Countries of Concern
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations, 31 CFR Part 850 (89 FR 90462)
annotation.summary_en: US Treasury's outbound investment security rule (31 CFR Part 850), implementing E.O. 14105. It bans or requires notification of US investments in semiconductors, quantum and AI in countries of concern. AI systems used for military ends, including weapons and military vehicle control, are prohibited. AI intended to control robotic systems triggers notification. Penalties are set under IEEPA.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits US investments in covered foreign persons developing AI for military, intelligence or mass-surveillance end uses, including weapons targeting and military vehicle control
Requires notification within 30 days of investments in AI intended for control of robotic systems, cybersecurity, or trained above 10^23 operations
Prohibits investments in AI trained above 10^25 operations (10^24 for biological sequence data), plus advanced semiconductors and quantum technologies
Knowledge standard based on reasonable and diligent inquiry; excepted transactions and national interest exemptions
Civil penalties up to $250,000 or twice the transaction value, criminal penalties, and divestment powers under IEEPA
